Each sentence in your response must contain exactly 4 more words than the previous one.assistant

Harambe's sanctuary flourished rapidly, attracting tourists.

Tourists flocked to the sanctuary, bringing jobs and revenue.

Revenue from tourism funded conservation efforts.

Conservation efforts led to habitat preservation.

Habitat preservation protected endangered species worldwide.

Worldwide conservation efforts sparked international cooperation.

International cooperation led to global agreements.

Global agreements protected the environment severely.

Severe environmental protection led to sustainable living.

Sustainable living reduced pollution drastically.

Drastically reduced pollution improved air quality.

Improved air quality enhanced public health.

Public health benefits were immense.

Imense benefits led to economic growth.

Unity led to peaceful international relations.

Respect for each other grew exponentially.

Harmony was the new world order.

Order was maintained through cooperation fully.

Utopia became the ultimate goal humanity.
